subject: English Home Language

source.topic: New life: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Identifies rhyming words in the story and makes up other rhyming words

show.line: Rhymes again! Cat, hat, bat. Dog, frog, log. Spring babies love to rhyme!

rounds.prompt: Chick. Which one rhymes with chick? Stick or nest? Say it.

rounds.story: A little lamb plays in the sun. It likes to jump and run. Which word rhymes with sun?

rounds.prompt: Does it rhyme with cat, or with dog? Put each one in its group.

hints: Listen to the end of the word. Cat, hat. Same ending!
Say both words. Do the ends sound the same?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a rhyme for cat.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cat and dog do not rhyme. Cat, hat!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Cat, hat. The ends sound the same!

parent_line: Can hear rhymes and find a rhyming word.
